subject: BUG-256: MD-100 midterm sim grades an INCOMPLETE and a BOGUS registry command as correct
description: Found 2026-09-04 while working task 335. forge-md100-midterm-sim.lab.html:1835 the Set-ItemProperty branch matches on substring only and defaults the value to 'disabled' when none is supplied: const val = cmd.match(/-Value\s+(\d)/i); state.registry.lockScreenAds = val ? val[1] !== '0' : false. Replicated the exact logic against four inputs; objective c5 ('Disable Lock Screen ads via Registry') PASSES for THREE of them: (1) the correct full command -- right; (2) 'Set-ItemProperty -Path "...ContentDeliveryManager"' with NO -Name and NO -Value -- wrong, an incomplete command is graded as mastery; (3) 'Set-ItemProperty -Path "totally-made-up contentdeliverymanager"' -- wrong, a nonexistent path passes because the check is a substring test; (4) '-Value 1' correctly fails. So a student who types a fragment, or an invented path containing the right word, is certified as having done it. This is the cheats-must-FAIL principle: a walkthrough proving the lab is completable is not the same as proving it cannot be passed without the skill. It also matters for task 335: the argument against wiring up 'reg add' is that a loose parser might grade a wrong command as correct, and the EXISTING parser already does exactly that, so tightening is required either way. Fix: validate the path contains CurrentVersion\ContentDeliveryManager, require -Name RotatingLockScreenEnabled, and require an explicit -Value rather than defaulting. Same audit is owed to the fdenytsconnections and enablelua branches directly below it, which were not examined.
